name: Baltimore
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Baltimore for 2026, and here is what he found: 40 family events, 14 of them free, after the suburb cards move to their own town pages. The magic runs from November 21 (Christmas Village in Baltimore at the Inner Harbor) into late December, with Charm City Lights at Druid Hill Park (November 28 to December 27), Monument Lighting (December 3) and the Mayor's Christmas Parade (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Baltimore

  • 40 Christmas events for kids in Baltimore
  • 14 free events, including the Mayor's Christmas Parade and Monument Lighting
  • Meet Santa: Meet Santa at Christmas Village, Fell's Point Olde Tyme Christmas and breakfasts with Santa across the city
  • Parades and lights: the Mayor's Christmas Parade (December 6) and Charm City Lights at Druid Hill Park, new this season
  • Trains: The Polar Express Train Ride and Holiday Festival of Trains at the B&O Railroad Museum, Santa's Streetcar at the Baltimore Streetcar Museum
  • Season: November 21 into late December

Baltimore is the hub for the Baltimore-area pages: Towson, Catonsville, Owings Mills, Middle River and White Marsh families use this guide for city events at the Inner Harbor, the B&O Railroad Museum and the Maryland Zoo.
